## Walkcast 0.10.3

### Reliability fix

- **Desktop startup after an interrupted shutdown:** the local file store now distinguishes a stale Windows process ID from the original lock owner. Windows can reuse process IDs after a forced stop; a reused ID no longer prevents Walkcast from starting against its existing local data.

### Notes

- Existing recordings and settings remain in the same local Walkcast data folder.
- If Walkcast is currently showing a startup error, close and reopen it after installing this release.
